title: ddpm_gnn
summary: A research project exploring denoising diffusion probabilistic models combined with graph neural networks for synthetic tabular data generation. It vendors an in-tree copy of the CTGAN package and calls its TVAESynthesizer directly in train_sample_tvae.py to train and sample synthetic data, likely as a comparison baseline to the DDPM/GNN approach.
evidence: CTGAN/train_sample_tvae.py:5-41 imports and instantiates TVAESynthesizer from vendored CTGAN/ctgan package
needs: Unclear whether CTGANSynthesizer itself (also imported in vendored __init__.py) is ever run, or only TVAESynthesizer; only the latter has a confirmed call site.
